name: WildGuard
description: WildGuard is an open, lightweight moderation tool for LLM safety that identifies malicious intent in user prompts, detects safety risks in model responses, and determines model refusal rates. It includes WildGuardMix, a large-scale multi-task safety moderation dataset with 92K labeled examples covering vanilla prompts and adversarial jailbreaks, and a high-quality human-annotated test set with 5K labeled items across 13 risk categories.
reputation: Widely cited as a practical open-source safety moderation benchmark/tool for prompt and response risk detection, especially for jailbreak and refusal evaluation.
notes: Covers 13 risk categories including adversarial jailbreaks and refusal detection; establishes state-of-the-art performance compared to existing open-source moderation models and matches or exceeds GPT-4 in some tasks.
